biotools.summary: BioNeuralNet is a Python framework utilizing Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) for comprehensive, end-to-end analysis of multi-omics network data. It enables the conversion of complex molecular interactions into versatile embeddings for downstream analysis in life science applications.
